name: Fairmont Grand Del Mar
positioning: Fairmont Grand Del Mar, a canyon-side golf and spa resort in San Diego, with a private Tom Fazio-designed golf course and a large spa
best_for: Golf and spa travelers who want a resort base in San Diego
Families who want suites or villas and outdoor activities on site

facts.text: Located on 400 acres alongside Los Peñasquitos Canyon Preserve, near Torrey Pines and Carmel Valley.
Amaya serves refined California-Mediterranean cuisine, casual poolside fare and inventive cocktails during happy hour.
The spa is a wellness facility of 21,000 square feet with massages, hydrotherapy, aromatherapy and restorative lounges.
Rooms, suites and villas have marble bathrooms, large balconies or terraces, and views of the gardens, the golf club or the canyon preserve.
Villa Sorrento is a secluded one-story villa with three master bedrooms, each with a private bathroom.
Larger suites and villas suit families or extended stays.
Torrey Pines State Reserve trails, Del Mar racetrack events and the One Paseo culinary district are nearby.
Fitness classes are complimentary for resort guests.
The concierge can arrange golf tee times, spa experiences, private excursions and dining reservations.
Guests can play tennis or pickleball on the resort's courts.

highlights.text: Grounds include a grove of eucalyptus trees and a waterfall cascading through ancient volcanic rock.
The resort has an 18-hole private golf course designed by Tom Fazio.
The resort offers about two dozen weekly outdoor activities, including hiking, horseback trail rides, yoga, meditation and archery.

considerations.text: The resort is not beachfront, though it is close to Del Mar's beaches, boutique shopping and surf breaks for light day trips.
Grand Social seasonal outdoor events are held during the summer months.
WhataHotel notes the resort location is away from downtown San Diego.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Fairmont Grand Del Mar
